visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a black athletic tank top, stands in a lush outdoor park environment with sunlight filtering through green trees. He looks directly at the camera and points his right index finger emphatically at a large black smartwatch worn on his left wrist, while white subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen. (2) The camera transitions to a top-down view of two rugged black smartwatches placed on a light-colored wooden table. Text labels 'Fenix 8' and 'Fenix 8 Pro' are positioned above the watches, which show colorful interface displays. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the silicone straps and metallic bezels. (3) A close-up side profile comparison shows the edges of the two watches. The 'Fenix 8 Pro' model features a distinct red metallic ring around the functional button, while the standard 'Fenix 8' has a gray button. The watches are held against a dark background, making the red accent point stand out clearly. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the screen of the smartwatch outdoors. The display shows a detailed topographical map interface with red and orange contour lines. Large yellow 'Micro LED' text overlays the screen briefly as the watch is tilted to show the high-contrast display under natural daylight. (5) Indoors, the man is shown from the chest up, holding a smartwatch while a product box sits on the table behind him. He points at the device and speaks. The setting is a cozy living room with soft indoor lighting and a bookshelf in the background, creating a professional yet personal atmosphere. (6) The video shows a sequence of the man performing physical activities in the park, including jogging through a sun-dappled path and doing push-ups on a textured black mat. He wears the watch throughout these scenes, which are filmed with a handheld following camera that captures his athletic movements.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator speaks Mandarin with an energetic and professional tone, characterized by a fast speech rate and high vocal intensity. The background music consists of a rhythmic electronic-pop track with a prominent bass line and bright synthesizer melodies. The overall acoustic environment is clean, with minimal ambient noise interference. (2) A sharp, synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect marks a visual transition, followed immediately by the narrator's continued fast-paced technical description. The BGM remains constant in volume and tempo, maintaining an upbeat vibe. The vocal clarity is excellent, with sharp articulation and a confident, authoritative pitch contour throughout the explanation. (3) The audio track features a rhythmic 'beeping' countdown sound effect, simulating an SOS emergency signal from the device. This sound is high-pitched and percussive, layered over the existing background music and narration. The narrator's voice drops slightly in volume to allow the digital chime to be heard clearly by the listener. (4) As the scene changes to a dark environment, the narrator's voice remains clear but takes on a slightly more intimate and informative quality. Occasional 'click' sound effects are heard as he demonstrates the device's flashlight function. The background music continues to provide a steady, mid-tempo rhythmic foundation for the entire duration of the audio. (5) The recording concludes with the narrator asking a question in a friendly and engaging tone, with a slight rising intonation at the end. The background music swells slightly in volume during the final seconds before a clean fade-out. The spectral balance remains bright and polished, indicating a professional post-production master track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Technical Comparison -> Feature Showcase (Screen, SOS, Flashlight) -> Action/Utility Demonstration -> Conclusion -> CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To review and promote the Garmin Fenix 8 Pro smartwatch, emphasizing its new Micro LED display, brightness, emergency SOS features, built-in flashlight, and long battery life through a high-energy comparison with previous models.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product, naming the brand multiple times, detailed feature analysis, and inclusion of price information.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses fast-paced editing and side-by-side comparisons to effectively highlight hardware upgrades. The high-energy narration and clear on-screen text make it highly engaging for a social media tech-savvy audience.
